title: Works well, but you can't frost the cake - only powder or light glaze or you lose all details.
text:
Works well, but you can't frost the cake - only powder or light glaze or you lose all details.. On the one hand, I do love it. I have had the large rose shape pan for several years. And while it does what it says, you may not notice what it doesn't do. Notice that none of the product photos show frosting. You can't frost this cake without burying/blurring all the details. And the tips of the petals break off easily if you try.
You can dust it with powdered sugar or drizzle a VERY thin glaze/melted frosting. But unless you are insanely carful, the glaze drips into the crevasses and fils hem in, losing the shape. Unless the actual cake has a pretty color, it looks blah without frosting.
(strawberry or red velvet cake mixes work best)
Also because it is so rigid, unless you grease and flour VERY well, the smaller details break off inside the pan when you release.
